briefdescription.para: Virt2PhysMap - This is a virtual to physical register mapping.

detaileddescription.para: Each virtual register is required to have an entry in it; even spilled virtual registers (the register mapped to a spilled register is the temporary used to load it from the stack).

briefdescription.para: Virt2StackSlotMap - This is virtual register to stack slot mapping.

detaileddescription.para: Each spilled virtual register has an entry in it which corresponds to the stack slot this register is spilled at.

briefdescription.para: Virt2SplitMap - This is virtual register to splitted virtual register mapping.
Virt2ShapeMap - For X86 AMX register whose register is bound shape information.
createSpillSlot - Allocate a spill slot for RC from MFI.
